caller_is_not_holder.meaning: transferFrom is invoked via an allowance so the caller (msg.sender) is not the token holder whose balance is debited

event_from_address.meaning: first argument (from) of the Transfer event emitted by transferFrom

debited_holder_address.meaning: address whose balance is debited, i.e. the from parameter of transferFrom

ui_history_misleading.meaning: wallets and UIs displaying token history from events show misleading information about who sent tokens
ui_history_misleading.checkpoint: after event consumption by off-chain UIs

assumptions: The Transfer event's first argument is the from address consumed by off-chain history/UI tooling.
The debited holder address is the from parameter passed to transferFrom.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric or structural definition linking the emitted event field to the debited holder beyond the stated identity; binding is deferred to code.

limitations: Only the misleading-UI-history impact is formalized; misattributed logs and reconstructed-balance impacts are handled in separate passes.
The correspondence is stated at the report level; concrete event encoding and consumer behavior are not modeled.
